fusions.name: Linked Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted link that deals 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Coffle
fusions.desc: Sweeps a length of links 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything in it and leaves them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on anything it hits spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Hauled Back
fusions.desc: Lays a line of links 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 25% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slack Taken Up
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a bolt leaps to the nearest other enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
